title: Lynn Fisher: about page as a printed CV (press, interviews, talks with years)
note: About is one narrow column in book type: a drop-cap bio with a small greyscale portrait, a pull quote, then SELECTED PRESS, INTERVIEWS and TALKS as plain lists with the year right-aligned on each row and hairline rules between. It is basically her CV, but set like a book appendix, so it reads as personality instead of a LinkedIn dump. The contents-page nav repeats at the bottom of every page. Worth reusing: experience as typeset lists with right-aligned years, and the same nav block closing every page.
